metadata_only_differences: Descriptive metadata, environment verification flag and documentation finalized after recording. Instruction and simulation code/plan are unchanged.

visual_review.method: Native front demo frames at 0, 7, 12, 20, 35 and 47 s; native front Dream frames at 0, 15, 22, 30, 45 and 60 s; source-verified trace replay.
visual_review.demo: The robot grips the handle, rocks the full-size pram repeatedly over the marked travel and releases it stopped. Trace confirms ten cycles and 6.6 seconds released rest.
visual_review.dream: Completes the full budget and moves the handle/pram, but performs no complete qualifying rock. Later arm contact stops at the carrycot shell rather than passing through its body.
visual_review.limitations: Reduced planar cart and idealized handle capture. Native carrycot/doll collision shells; no suspension, tipping, occupant dynamics or pram reaction forces fed back to the robot.
